{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent lows).",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., after 70+ peaks, cap next 3-5 days at 68–72 range).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive forecasts are above 70, reduce by 1–2 points; if below 65, raise by 1–2 points.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment rises from 0.00 to 0.50+ within 3 days, adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5 points.",
    "For 30-day horizon, avoid over-optimism in early days (days 1–5); cap forecast at 10% below recent 15-day high.",
    "If true outcome exceeds forecast by >3 points for 2+ consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 1–2 points to avoid overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment history includes 0.33+ (positive sentiment), slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 75–78 if recent highs are above 72."
  ]
}
